_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. The Settings window as home.rs draws it: the panes' names, the Set Up button, General (Language, Copyright, Song files), the Screens pane, Groups, Key Mappings, About and the Command line card. Rows of lang-tables.js of the design were used where they exist (Screens, General, Groups, Keys, Integrations, Copyright, Song files, Reload songs, Set up SoftPresenter…).
